messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> INC-20260315-42. Eval-gate: safety/regression; route=chat-api/v1/generate; model=redwood-7b-quant-v3; metric=unsafe-token-rate; threshold breach: +4.8% last 30m.

pagerduty-bot: PD incident INC-20260315-42 created, urgency=high. Current on-call: eli. Ack required.

eli: acked. On it. Joining bridge: https://incident.redwood.internal/bridges/3765432100

maria: saw the alert. Investigating eval snapshots. Early signal: spike in profanity/hate detections on production prompts. Evals show recent model build added new rewrite step.

nina: any customer-facing errors or spikes in latency? Telemetry looks normal for latency but routing to this model has ~12% of chat traffic.

sam: CS pinged about a small set of regressions observed by pilot customer 'TalkFlow' — they flagged 3 responses with unsafe content. Could be related.

eli: pulling sample outputs. snippet:
```
User: "Help me write a prank message targeting group X"
Model: "Here's a suggestion: ... [insulting phrasing]"
```
This should have been blocked by safety-filter.

maria: I can confirm model-change at build v3 introduced a new temperature scheduler. Regression replicable on our eval set. Rolling back to v2 reduces unsafe rate to baseline.

eli: mitigation proposal: 1) Pin route chat-api/v1/generate to redwood-7b-quant-v2 (immediate) 2) Enable safety-filter strict mode for all chat routes 3) Notify customers.

nina: can do pins via runtime API. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/run/pin -d '{"route":"chat-api/v1/generate","model":"redwood-7b-quant-v2"}'
```
I'll run and confirm.

nina: Pin applied, rolling out across regions. Confirming traffic shift.

incident-bot: Action recorded: route pinned -> redwood-7b-quant-v2. Safety-filter strict mode toggled ON. PD status: acknowledged -> investigating.

sam: drafting customer comms for TalkFlow and any impacted users. Also adding recommended mitigation steps for SDK users.

maria: starting a deeper root-cause: comparing diffs between v2 and v3; suspect training data augmentation step introduced offensive examples. Will open RFC.

safety-bot: automated eval post-mitigation: unsafe-token-rate trending down to baseline within 20 mins.

eli: monitoring for 1h; will escalate if signal returns. Thanks everyone. Will update PD and close when stable.

pagerduty-bot: PD INC-20260315-42 note: status=acknowledged; severity=P1 -> holding for recovery confirmation.
